searchText: I'm trying out retroactivation of EVM opcodes on Ethereum mainnet - so far I have managed to retroactivate from genesis and successfully sync with: * DELEGATECALL * RETURNDATASIZE * RETURNDATACOPY * STATICCALL I did hit consensus failure with REVERT retroactivated, so that switch has to stay. Do you mean to pretend that they existed from the very beginning? yes that it a very interesting idea the main reason is that I want to reduce the number of switches in EVM and chainspecs with REVERT, if the number of txs that hit consensus issues are not large, it might be a good trade-off to make them exceptions and retroactivate REVERT the same with INVALID opcode the failture was ~3 000 000 block. I think it worth it to try further and collect such exceptional transactions like I did with JUMPDEST analysis. It turns out that there were only 3 transactions on the mainnet where jumpdest analysis actually makes a difference that was for a different purpose though (optimisation)

* RETURNDATASIZE
* RETURNDATACOPY
* STATICCALL
